VBO:0201343.summary: Terriers developed around vermin hunting and related farm or household work. The group ranges from small Cairn and Border Terriers to the much larger Airedale; its members have distinct breed histories and builds.
VBO:0201343.shortDescription: A vermin-hunting breed group ranging from small Cairn and Border Terriers to the much larger Airedale.

sources.title: AKC: Terrier Group
sources.evidence: Group introduction describes vermin hunting and guarding home or barn; identifies smaller Cairn/Norfolk/West Highland White versus larger Airedale. Member list includes Border Terrier.
